outdated.reason: Network-backed npm registry query is not authoritative in an offline packaged workspace.

rules.lockfile: npm lockfileVersion 3 is required and every direct dependency must have a matching lock entry.
rules.registry: Git/file/link dependencies require explicit review and are never silently accepted as runtime dependencies.
rules.lifecycle: Install lifecycle scripts require review because they execute code during dependency installation.
rules.updates: Major runtime updates require review before promotion; minor/patch updates should be refreshed routinely.
rules.vulnerabilities: High/critical npm audit findings must block CI unless formally remediated or waived with owner and expiry.
